name: Aqua Lares
waters: Seychelles and Zanzibar in the northern winter; Svalbard, Arctic Norway and the Scottish Isles in summer

seo.title: Aqua Lares: Seychelles, Aldabra and Svalbard Superyacht | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Aqua Lares by Aqua Expeditions: a 77 m icebreaker superyacht, 15 cabins, 30 guests, 32 crew. Seychelles, Aldabra and Zanzibar; Svalbard and Arctic Norway from June 2026. Every fare.

tagline: A 77-metre icebreaker superyacht: Aldabra in winter, Svalbard in summer.
answer: Aqua Lares is Aqua Expeditions' 77-metre icebreaker superyacht, the first, says Aqua, to sell single cabins as well as private charters in East Africa and the Norwegian Arctic. She carries 30 guests in 15 cabins with 32 crew. From late in the year she sails the Seychelles, Aldabra and Zanzibar for five to 14 nights; from June 2026 she sails Svalbard, Arctic Norway and the Scottish Isles. She suits travellers who want remote islands, or polar bears, with superyacht service.
facts: 15 in five categories, including 3 Owner's Suites of 39 to 66 sq m
Seychelles and Zanzibar; Svalbard, Norway and Scotland; 5 to 14 nights
overview: Aqua Lares carries 30 guests in 15 cabins across six decks with 32 crew, more than one for every guest. Three Owner's Suites run from 39 to 66 sq m (419 to 710 sq ft); the other cabins from 13 to 30 sq m. Interiors use Dedar fabrics, Minotti and Poltrona Frau furniture and Gaya Ceramics tableware, with antique maps and prints.

She has a sun deck lounge and bar, a heli deck lounge with daybeds, a saloon, a cinema, al fresco dining, an outdoor jacuzzi and swim platform, and a lower deck spa with a sauna, a massage room and a gym. Michelin-starred chef Karime López writes her menus for each region. In the Indian Ocean she reaches Aldabra, Assumption, Astove, Alphonse and the Amirantes; in the Arctic, Longyearbyen, Smeerenburg, Hinlopen and the pack ice.

faqs: How much does Aqua Lares cost?
Aqua lists five nights in the Seychelles from about US$9,300 per person in Category V; Owner's Suites and longer voyages cost more. Every departure is in the table on this page.
From about November to April, the Seychelles (Mahé, Praslin, La Digue, Aldabra and the outer islands) and Zanzibar and Mafia in Tanzania; from June, Svalbard, Arctic Norway and the Scottish Isles.
Can I see polar bears on Aqua Lares?
Her Svalbard voyages reach the pack ice, polar bear country, and walrus haul-outs; sightings are never promised.
Yes. Aqua sells her by the cabin and as a whole-yacht charter for up to 30.
Aqua calls her an icebreaker superyacht: her hull is built for ice, which takes her into Svalbard's fjords and to the pack ice edge.
